시편 147:1.content: Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

시편 147:2.content: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

시편 147:3.content: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

시편 147:4.content: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

시편 147:5.content: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

시편 147:6.content: The Lord lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

시편 147:7.content: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

시편 147:8.content: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

시편 147:9.content: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

시편 147:10.content: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

시편 147:11.content: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

시편 147:12.content: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

시편 147:13.content: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

시편 147:14.content: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

시편 147:15.content: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

시편 147:16.content: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

시편 147:17.content: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

시편 147:18.content: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

시편 147:19.content: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

시편 147:20.content: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.
